title: pimp~

flags.name: -mc <list>
flags.description: sets multichannel output with a list of frequencies

flags.name: -midi
flags.description: sets frequency input in MIDI pitch (default Hz)

flags.name: -soft
flags.description: sets to soft sync mode (default hard)

methods.description: nonzero sets to frequency input in MIDI pitch
<channel, freq> set a single frequency channel
nonzero sets to soft sync mode

body: [pimp~] is a combination of [phasor~] and [imp~] (alias of [impulse~]). It's [imp~] with an extra phase output (left outlet). The impulse happens at every phase period start (in both negative or positive frequencies/directions). It also has inlets for phase sync and phase modulation like [imp~].
